newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria prosecutor drops telecom case.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria prosecutor drops telecom case.

text.p: The Bulgarian prosecutor's office on Wednesday dropped an investigation into the Bulgarian Telecommunications Company's cancellation of a contract with U.S.-based Global Communications Inc, state radio said.
It said the prosecutor's office had concluded there was no case to answer.

Bulgarian Telecommunications Company unilaterally cancelled its contract with Global last July because the company had not paid its debts since 1994 and BTC's new management decided the contract contravened Bulgarian law by allowing Global to handle international calls.

State news agency BTA said Global, which had been operating an international long-distance service for big hotels, owed BTC 128 million levs until last October for hired lines and international call traffic.
